notes.title: Alpha 0.6.0
notes.content:
Hello @Travellers !

We finally welcome [b]Alpha version 0.6.0 of Swappy World![/b] The update is already available on Steam, you should be able to download it shortly 🙂

As promised: there are many important new features, but they mainly concern important stability and bugfix work that we have been carrying out over the last few weeks to ensure the best possible experience, also based on your feedback and the bugs you have reported. 

Enjoy your journey, everyone!

[b]Important[/b]: Update save version to 3: previous save data will be deleted. We’re sorry for this, but it’s very important because we notice that many bugs can be attributed to broken saves from older versions of the game.

[b]Added[/b]

[list]
[*] Copper pickaxe (more durability and deal 3 damage to rock / metal deposits)
[*] Iron Pickaxe (more durability and deal 5 damage to rock / metal deposits)
[*] Copper axe (more durability and deal 3 damage to trees)
[*] Iron axe(more durability and deal 5 damage to trees)
[/list]

[b]Rebalancing[/b]

[list]
[*] Maximum carry weight 40 → 60
[*] Log weight 8 → 5
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] fix wrong red item slot in inventory after drop a broken item
[*] Fix card overlapping in caves
[*] Fix quest sistem
[*] Fix weight bug in object information (regardings floating weight values, for examples you saw 1 weight for stone instead of 0.5)
[*] Fix the repair of objects
[*] Fix double item consumption in belt
[*] Fix the item saving bug
[*] Fix drop system
[*] Fix broken biomes after save
[*] Fix the rotation of the cards overnight
[*] Fix object that stays on the belt even after use
[*] Fix mapping of buttons in inventory
[*] Fix Particle system biomas
[*] Fix flower, inserted a maximum capacity to restore energy
[*] Fix resources required below zero
[*] Fix durability torch
[*] Fix respawn animal
[*] Fix punch damage on creatures
[*] Fix animation cards
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update for the steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We are pleased to announce that we have released a very important update to Swappy World!
As you can see, we have changed the cover and in the new version you will find:

[list]
[*] The main menu
[*] The game options
[*] The language selection (at the moment there are only 3, but soon all other languages will be added)
[*] The possibility to save and resume the game (saves are automatic when sleeping)
[*] A gripping Boss Fight that catapults you into the heart of the game's lore!
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[*] Lots of aesthetic improvements that you will notice immediately!
[/list]

To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we've decided to take part in live streaming broadcasts to show gameplays made by us!

We would like to take this opportunity to update you on what we will be introducing next in the game:
[list]
[*] Building a house
[*] Tame a horse (or maybe a monster?) and ride it
[*] Build a farm to grow crops
[*] Explore up to 12 different biomes!
[*] ... and above all take advantage of an improved combat system full of new features!
[/list]

Don't forget to join the official discord:

A loving hug!
Awakening Team

notes.title: SWAPPY WORLD DEMO OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h1]SWAPPY WORLD DEMO OUT NOW!![/h1]

We are pleased to announce that the playable version of the pre-alpha demo of Swappy World is finally online!

First of all: Awakening Games is a small software house publishing for the first time on Steam its videogame it cares about. Our mission is to create content that is shared as much as possible with users and then build a community around it: to listen to opinions and suggestions that come from users. This is because we really care about this game and throughout the development period (which we assume to be about 1 year) we would like to create as smooth and enjoyable an experience as possible.

This is why Swappy World will be a fully moddable game: any user will be able to create their own Biomes, their own Cards, their own Items, and so on, to the point where they can almost reinvent something new!

We are aware that the game is still far from final development and at present there are several bugs to be fixed, but we will update the demo often with these [b]fixes[/b].

A full [b]Roadmap [/b]will be available soon, outlining all the next steps of development.

But despite this we still want to update you on what we intend to develop very soon, in the coming weeks:

[list]
[*] bugfixes
[*] multilingual support
[*] support for saves (also in the cloud)
[*] development of the first boss fight
[*] hint of plot: we are working on a catchy, fully animated opening movie!
[/list]

It is very important for us to know what you think of the project, and please feel free to write to us or leave comments that will help us improve what we are doing.

Enjoy!

Awakening Games Team
